test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Why is the iron and steel industry called a basic industry?

options.text: Because it provides essential raw materials, machinery, and tools to a wide range of other industries
Because it processes naturally available iron ores
Because it mainly produces household consumer items
Because it provides raw materials for other industries

solution:
The correct answer is __**Because it provides essential raw materials, machinery, and tools to a wide range of other industries**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The iron and steel industry is referred to as a basic industry because it supplies raw materials, machinery, and tools to numerous other industries including construction, transportation, and manufacturing.
 
• It serves as the backbone of industrial development, enabling the production of goods and infrastructure.
 
• Steel is integral to the production of equipment, vehicles, and machinery used across industries, highlighting its foundational role.
 
• Industries like shipbuilding, automobile manufacturing, and heavy engineering rely heavily on iron and steel as their primary materials.
 
• Its contribution extends to infrastructure development, including bridges, railways, and buildings, making it a key industry in economic growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iron Ore:** The primary raw material used in the production of iron and steel. India is rich in iron ore reserves, making the industry a major contributor to the economy.
 
• **Steel Production:** Involves processes such as smelting iron ore in blast furnaces and refining it into steel through various methods like basic oxygen steelmaking or electric arc furnaces.
 
• **Infrastructure Dependency:** Modern infrastructure projects, such as bridges, highways, and skyscrapers, heavily depend on steel for durability and strength.
 
• **Employment Generation:** The iron and steel industry is a significant source of employment, directly and indirectly supporting millions of workers globally.
 
• **Global Relevance:** Countries with advanced iron and steel industries, such as China and the USA, hold competitive positions in global economic development.
